verdict.rationale: Numeral lets developers create and categorize products via `/tax/products` and offers 'AI product classification' as a feature, implying products are mapped to tax categories that drive jurisdiction-specific calculation (docs-2, docs-19, docs-26, docs-36). However, the evidence never enumerates or documents specific category taxonomies (e.g., SaaS vs digital goods vs services vs physical goods) or shows how category choice changes taxability rules per jurisdiction. Missing for 10: an explicit taxonomy/category list, documentation of category-specific jurisdiction rules, and independent confirmation that categorization output matches real-world tax treatment.
